proposed.text: What standard of care do architects owe to their clients and third parties under the quasi-delict framework?

options.text: Best professional effort without regard to standard practices, ensuring that all client needs are met regardless of industry norms
The degree of skill, diligence, and knowledge ordinarily exercised by licensed architects
Absolute perfection in all technical aspects, leaving no room for error in any phase of the project
Reasonable effort to meet project deadlines, focusing on timely delivery rather than technical precision

rationale.a: Substitutes subjective effort for objective standard; the law requires conformance to professional norms, not personal best efforts.
rationale.c: Overstates the requirement; the standard is reasonable professional care, not absolute perfection.
rationale.d: Narrows the focus to deadlines; the professional standard encompasses all aspects of competent design and execution, not just schedule.
rationale.correct: The professional standard of care is measured against the degree of skill, diligence, and knowledge ordinarily exercised by licensed architects in the Philippines under similar circumstances. Deviation from accepted professional practices, code violations, or failure to consult specialists when necessary breaches this standard.
rationale.takeaway: Professional standard of care: skill, diligence, and knowledge ordinarily exercised by licensed architects under similar circumstances.
